name: The Christmas, my Rival, and I
source:
The protagonist usually loves Christmas, but isn't that excited this year. After meeting Liana, a girl who has been the protagonist's rival (even though both had a crush on each other) for years, s/he learns why.

[From [url=http://games.renpy.org/game/xmasrival.shtml]Ren'Py Archive[/url]]
